classificationUpdates.inventorySource: PUN inventory snapshot from canonical Italy reconstruction
classificationUpdates.tariffModel: country-wide standard tariff with explicit motorway-station exception
classificationUpdates.tariffChannel: direct CPO; Electra app/Autocharge and bank-card terminal kept separate from roaming RFID
conditions: Electra's current official tariff page dated 2026-07-01 states Italy AC/DC charging is EUR 0.69/kWh when started with the Electra app and EUR 0.79/kWh when paid by bank card at the terminal.

The same first-party page explicitly states that motorway/rest-area stations have different prices and that the applicable tariff is the one shown on the station terminal; therefore the standard Italy grid must not be applied to motorway stations.
RFID/interoperable charging may incur third-party costs and is not substituted for the direct CPO tariff.

coveredSubpopulations.scope: ELC stations in Italy that are not motorway/rest-area stations
coveredSubpopulations.rule: direct app/Autocharge EUR 0.69/kWh; direct bank-card terminal EUR 0.79/kWh
coveredSubpopulations.rankableCondition: station must be deterministically classified as non-motorway in the station/EVSE inventory before promotion
coveredSubpopulations.reason: tariff rule is first-party and deterministic, but the canonical ELC inventory still lacks a lossless motorway/non-motorway flag for all 514 EVSE

uncoveredSubpopulations.reason: first-party Electra tariff page explicitly excludes motorway stations from the standard Italy tariff and requires station-terminal pricing
uncoveredSubpopulations.resumeCondition: exact station/EVSE mapping plus current terminal/app tariff for every motorway exception, or a first-party machine-readable station price endpoint

positiveEvidence: Current Electra help-center tariff page publishes a fixed Italy standard price of EUR 0.69/kWh in-app and EUR 0.79/kWh by bank card, for AC and DC.

Electra's official station pages currently expose motorway-labelled Italian sites such as A4 Casello Bergamo, Palazzolo-sull'Oglio and Cambiago, confirming that the motorway exception is materially present in the Italian ELC network.
Official station pages expose connector count and power, but not the exact current numeric motorway price in crawlable text.
negativeEvidence: No safe network-wide promotion: Electra explicitly says motorway prices differ from the rest of the network.
No exact full motorway EVSE list could be derived from the stale canonical snapshot alone in this run.
No roaming/eMSP tariff was used as a substitute for Electra direct pricing.
classificationUpdates.blockage: Need deterministic ELC station/EVSE motorway classification and exact current motorway prices before 514/514 can be made rankable.
classificationUpdates.resumeCondition: Map all ELC EVSE to Electra station slugs/locations, isolate motorway/rest-area subset, apply standard tariff only to verified non-motorway EVSE, then resolve motorway price per station/terminal/backend.

coverage.failClosed: all ELC EVSE until motorway/non-motorway classification is deterministic in the candidate generation path
